title: NetworkTag
description: A papi name for your proxy used in multiple different proxies used for a server so you can change the name for a proxy
body:
**USE OF THIS PLUGIN:**

When you have 2 (or more) velocity servers connected to the same backend and you want to show a different network name for the proxy you joined with.


**HOW YOU USE THIS PLUGIN:**

You put the velocity plugin in the velocity server and change the proxy name in the config, then you put the spigot plugin in the backend with placeholder api installed and the players who join on a modern set velocity server will show the set username with the placeholder %network_name%
